description.value:
Customers sign in with their company identity.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Log in with Google Workspace (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC)
- [ ] Sessions expire after 7 days
- [ ] Rate-limit failed logins

Password login is no longer needed.
